stages.label: Cultivation
stages.description: Tea bushes are shaded for several weeks before harvest, reducing sunlight exposure. This increases the chlorophyll and amino acid content, giving matcha its vibrant green color and unique flavor.

stages.label: Harvest
stages.description: Only the high-grade young tea leaves are selected. Stem, veins, and other impurities are removed in this process.

stages.label: Processing
stages.description: Leaves are then immediately steamed to prevent oxidation, dried, and then stone-ground into a fine powder.

benefits.label: Enhanced Cognitive Function
benefits.description: Matcha contains caffeine, L-theanine, and catechins that improve memory, attention, and stress resilience. It helps reduce reaction time and enhances cognitive performance under stress.

benefits.label: Cardio-Metabolic Health
benefits.description: Matcha improves cholesterol and blood glucose levels, promoting heart health. Regular consumption helps in maintaining a healthy weight and reducing fat accumulation. Its high antioxidant content aids in combating oxidative stress and inflammation.

benefits.label: Stress Reduction
benefits.description: Rich in L-theanine, matcha promotes relaxation and reduces anxiety and physiological stress markers.
